instruction: Look at seed_ss_gui_12_double_slot.dxf and continue editing that drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Use the existing plate and slot-center guides to create the final 180 x 60 flat plate. Add two identical horizontal slots with centers at (60,30) and (120,30). Each slot has length 36 and width 10. The slots must be exactly identical and their centerline must be horizontal. Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. Save the completed drawing as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_12.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
